# Final action checklist

The single ordered list to work through before and during pilot launch. Do each item in order — later items assume earlier ones are done. Nothing in this repository publishes, sends, merges, or deploys automatically; every checkbox below is a manual action outside this repository (browser, email client, LinkedIn, hosting dashboard), except items 8-9 which are the actual merge/deploy.

---

### 1. Review the flagship report
**File**: the live page at `/reports/india-in-hand-salary-model-2026`, generated by `lib/growth/in-hand-salary-model.ts`.
**Section**: the full page — key findings, the 12-level CTC table, and the disclaimer block at the bottom.
**Verify**: the numbers and findings still read correctly to you, including the corrected Section 87A finding (100% marginal rate on income tax before cess, 104% on total tax including cess — see `02-tax-wording-certification.md`).
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: if anything reads wrong, stop here and flag it — every downstream item links back to this report.

### 2. Review the five visual assets
**Files**: `public/growth-assets/required-ctc-report-2026/{in-hand-by-ctc, required-ctc, pf-comparison, employer-cost-scenarios, waterfall}-{1200x630,1080x1350}.png`.
**Section**: `docs/growth/launch-assets.md` has the accessible-text description and source data for each.
**Verify**: each chart is readable on mobile, matches the number it claims to show, and carries the SalaryExit footer/branding correctly.
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: these are the images referenced in `READY-LINKEDIN-WEEK-1-2.md` — confirm the file names there still match what's on disk.

### 3. Review the six personal-profile LinkedIn posts
**File**: `docs/growth/manual-approval/READY-LINKEDIN-WEEK-1-2.md`, items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7.
**Section**: full post text for each, including the tax-wording-corrected post (item 6, Day 10).
**Verify**: no `[link]` placeholder remains in any post; the two linked posts (items 4 and 7) point to `/reverse-salary-calculator`; item 6's tax claim matches `02-tax-wording-certification.md`.
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: proceed to item 4.

### 4. Review the one company-page post
**File**: `docs/growth/manual-approval/READY-LINKEDIN-WEEK-1-2.md`, item 3 (Day 4).
**Section**: full post text.
**Verify**: the post links to the flagship report with the exact UTM URL shown, and that you have posting access to the SalaryExit India company page (not just the personal profile).
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: LinkedIn content is fully reviewed — proceed to outreach.

### 5. Review the first five outreach emails
**File**: `docs/growth/manual-approval/READY-OUTREACH-WEEK-1-2.md`, items 1-5 (HR Katha, India Briefing, ClearTax, Naukri Campus, Careers360).
**Section**: subject, body, campaign URL, and follow-up draft for each.
**Verify**: each body's personalization is factually accurate to the named article/resource, no `{{...}}` placeholder remains, and the contact route listed is one you're willing to send through (mostly general contact forms, not named individuals — see each item's contact-route note).
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: proceed to item 6.

### 6. Review the remaining approved outreach email
**File**: `docs/growth/manual-approval/READY-OUTREACH-WEEK-1-2.md`, item 6 (Groww blog).
**Section**: subject, body, campaign URL, follow-up draft.
**Verify**: same checks as item 5.
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: all 6 editorial emails are reviewed. The 7th (IIT Madras) is handled separately in item 7, since it's gated on the PDF, not just on content review.

### 7. Review the college PDF
**File**: `docs/growth/college-resource/first-offer-reality-guide.pdf` (+ source `.html`).
**Section**: full document — all 10 sections, and the disclaimer footer stating Aniket is not a CA/tax lawyer/payroll professional.
**Verify**: content and tone are ready to send to a placement office under your name — this is the one sign-off `09-college-resource-approval.md` explicitly leaves unchecked pending your review.
- [ ] Reviewed and approved
**Then**: tick the final box in `09-college-resource-approval.md`. This unblocks `READY-OUTREACH-WEEK-1-2.md` item 7 (IIT Madras) for sending on Day 11 — everything else in this checklist does not depend on this approval.

### 8. Approve deployment
**File**: this branch, `growth-authority-system` — review via `git diff main...growth-authority-system` or a pull request.
**Section**: the full diff — code (`lib/growth/analytics-baseline.ts`, `scripts/growth/`), tests, and all `docs/growth/` content.
**Verify**: `npm test` and `npm run build` both pass (see "Verification" below), no calculator/tax-config files were touched, and you're comfortable merging this branch to `main`.
- [ ] Approved
**Then**: merge to `main` (manual git action — not performed by this session).

### 9. Deploy
**File**: n/a — hosting dashboard (Vercel or equivalent).
**Section**: production deployment of `main` after the merge in item 8.
**Verify**: the production build succeeds and the live site reflects the merged branch.
- [ ] Deployed
**Then**: the flagship report and all calculators are live on the version this pilot was built against.

### 10. Request report indexing
**File**: Google Search Console (external), property `sc-domain:salaryexit.in`. Context: `docs/growth/00-baseline.md` → "Flagship report indexing" — confirmed via `mcp__gsc__index_inspect` that the report page is currently "unknown to Google."
**Section**: Search Console's URL Inspection tool → "Request Indexing" for `https://www.salaryexit.in/reports/india-in-hand-salary-model-2026`.
**Verify**: the URL is the live, deployed one (post item 9), not a preview URL.
- [ ] Requested
**Then**: this is a zero-cost action that doesn't depend on any social/outreach approval — worth doing as soon as the report is live, independent of Day 1.

### 11. Execute Day 1
**File**: `docs/growth/manual-approval/READY-LINKEDIN-WEEK-1-2.md`, item 1.
**Section**: the Day 1 post text and image.
**Verify**: everything above (items 1-4, 8-9) is done first — Day 1 is the first live action of the pilot.
- [ ] Posted
**Then**: log the post time, then follow the Day 3/4/5/8/9/10/11/12 schedule in `05-week-1-2-execution-queue.md` and `week-1-2-execution.csv`.

### 12. Review analytics on Friday
**File**: `docs/growth/growth-dashboard-spec.md` → "Weekly review format" and "Baseline-relative pilot thresholds."
**Section**: pull the 14 listed metrics for the trailing 7 days; compare against the continue/modify/stop thresholds in `04-pilot-thresholds.md`.
**Verify**: update `outreach-ledger.csv` and `week-1-2-execution.csv`'s `approval_status`/outcome fields with whatever actually happened that week.
- [ ] Reviewed
**Then**: apply the decision rules per channel — continue, modify, or stop — and repeat weekly for the remainder of the four-week pilot.

```bash
npm test
npm run build
```

Confirm: no calculator logic changed (`lib/calculators/` untouched), no tax configuration changed (`lib/config/financial-year.ts` untouched), no unresolved `[link]` placeholders in `READY-LINKEDIN-WEEK-1-2.md`, no `{{...}}` placeholders in `READY-OUTREACH-WEEK-1-2.md`, every active outreach prospect in `week-1-2-execution.csv` is eligible per `08-outreach-approval-checklist.md`, no duplicate organizations across the 7 outreach items, every campaign URL uses valid UTMs, Reddit remains blocked, and nothing has been published or sent.
